<script> (function(){ var SUBS={'学校体育学':'校体','运动生理学':'生理','运动训练学':'训练'},TXT={'校体':'果子学校体育学','生理':'果子运动生理学','训练':'果子运动训练学'}; function esc(s){return String(s).split('&').join('&').split('<').join('<').split('>').join('>')} function strip(s){var o='',i,c;for(i=0;i<s.length;i++){c=s.charCodeAt(i);if(c===32||c===10||c===13||c===9||c===12288||c===160)continue;o+=s.charAt(i)}return o} function info(){var a=document.querySelector('#study-card .q-source'),b=document.querySelector('#study-card .q-title');if(!a||!b)return null;var src=a.textContent||'',q=b.textContent||'',sub='',k;for(k in SUBS){if(src.indexOf(k)>=0){sub=SUBS[k];break}}if(!sub)return null;var i=src.indexOf('p');if(i<0)return null;var num='',c,j;for(j=i+1;j<src.length;j++){c=src.charCodeAt(j);if(c>=48&&c<=57)num+=src.charAt(j);else break}if(!num)return null;return{sub:sub,page:parseInt(num,10),q:q,src:src}} function mark(txt,q){var key=strip(q);if(key.length>16)key=key.slice(0,16);if(key.length<4)return esc(txt);var st=strip(txt),pos=st.indexOf(key);if(pos<0)return esc(txt);var si=0,start=-1,end=-1,i,c;for(i=0;i<txt.length;i++){c=txt.charCodeAt(i);if(c===32||c===10||c===13||c===9||c===12288||c===160)continue;if(si===pos&&start<0)start=i;si++;if(si===pos+key.length){end=i+1;break}}if(start<0||end<0)return esc(txt);return esc(txt.slice(0,start))+'<mark>'+esc(txt.slice(start,end))+'</mark>'+esc(txt.slice(end))} window.DXSRC={SUBS:SUBS,TXT:TXT,esc:esc,strip:strip,info:info,mark:mark}; })(); </script></body>
